objective: Verify which Claude Code settings a plugin can ship and which holyclaude defaults users must set themselves.
scope: Current official Claude Code documentation (plugins reference, settings, environment variables, subagents, model config, CHANGELOG) as of October 2026.
constraints: Cite the doc page for each claim; separate documented facts from inference.
acceptance_criteria: States exactly which keys a plugin's settings.json (or other plugin files) can set, and for each candidate default (autoCompactWindow or CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW, CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT, permissions deny of fork and built-in agents, promptCacheTtl, subagentPromptCacheTtl, deniedModels, CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL, gh allow rules) whether a plugin can apply it, with the source.
Checks the facts in the current README section (the value range and precedence of autoCompactWindow, managed-only keys, cache TTL keys) and lists any that are wrong or outdated.
result: Plugin settings.json honors only agent and subagentStatusLine (confirmed). Plugin agent frontmatter supports autoCompactWindow, model, effort, tools, experimental.cacheTtl. CLAUDE_ENV_FILE reaches only Bash, so fork mode, root cache TTL and root compaction are not hook-settable. A PreToolUse hook on Agent can deny by tool_input.subagent_type (fork, general-purpose, Explore, Plan; verify empirically). deniedModels managed-only. CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL redundant. Version 2.1.288 for per-model autoCompactWindow unverified.

acceptance.rationale: Cited doc answers; unverified items flagged and to be tested.
